title.th: คำสั่งตามมาตรา 11(3)

completenessNote: 该法规为单篇法律文书，无分节结构；正文按官方 front 抬头逐字全录，共 2 条。

text.en:
Revised Edition of the Laws Act
(Chapter 275, Section 11(3))
Order under Section 11(3)
O 21
G.N. No. S 573/1999
REVISED EDITION 2001
(31st January 2001)
[30th December 1999]
Whereas pursuant to section 10 of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act, the Law Revision Commissioners have published in loose-leaf form the Acts set out in Part I of the Schedule as in force on 6th December 1999 and the Act set out in Part II of the Schedule as in force on 15th December 1999:
And Whereas it is provided under section 11(3) of the Revised Edition of the Laws Act that the Commissioners shall transmit to the President a copy of each of the loose-leaf edition of these Acts and the President may thereupon, by order published in the Gazette, specify that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, in all courts and for all purposes, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts:
Now therefore it is hereby ordered by the President that the loose-leaf edition of these Acts shall, with effect from 30th December 1999, be the sole and only proper law of Singapore in respect of those Acts.

THE SCHEDULE
Part I
1.The Banking Act (Chapter 19)
2.The Boundaries and Survey Maps Act (Chapter 25)
3.The Building Control Act (Chapter 29)
4.The Central Provident Fund Act (Chapter 36)
5.The Control of Vectors and Pesticides Act (Chapter 59)
6.The Electronic Transactions Act (Chapter 88)
7.The Geographical Indications Act (Chapter 117B)
8.The Hire-Purchase Act (Chapter 125)
9.The Holidays Act (Chapter 126)
10.The Income Tax Act (Chapter 134)
11.The Infectious Diseases Act (Chapter 137)
12.The Land Titles (Strata) Act (Chapter 158)
13.The Merchant Shipping (Civil Liability and Compensation for Oil Pollution) Act (Chapter 180)
14.The Monetary Authority of Singapore Act (Chapter 186)
15.he Parliamentary Elections Act (Chapter 218)
16.The Poisons Act (Chapter 234)
17.The Post Office Savings Bank of Singapore (Transfer of Undertakings and Dissolution) Act (Chapter 237)
18.The Presidential Elections Act (Chapter 240A)
19.The Prevention of Pollution of the Sea Act (Chapter 243)
20.The Private Hospitals and Medical Clinics Act (Chapter 248)
21.The Singapore Totalisator Board Act (Chapter 305A)
22.The Statistics Act (Chapter 317)
23.The Trade Marks Act (Chapter 332)
Part II
The Copyright Act (Chapter 63)
[G.N. No. S 573/99]
